messages.author: 0b5beed5d9326e1e
messages.subject: GT3X firmware version
parts:
Hi everybody

first, as a newbie in actigraphy data analysis, my congratulations to GGIR developers.

My question is: according to vignette we can read in gt3x directly only the newer format generated with firmware versions above 2.5.0

My files were produced with firmware 1.7.2, still I read them using GGIR and managed to get results

Can I trust the procedure despite the older firmware?

Thanks

Ciao
Stefano

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GT3X firmware version
parts:
Hi Stefano,

I followed the documentation of R package read.gt3x on this, GGIR uses read.gt3x as a dependencies. If your output looks plausible then I think you are fine, because GGIR should produce a warning when you try to process a non-compatible .gt3x formatted file.

Best,

Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
